name: Asagiri Sachie
source:
Another servant at the Mamiya Manor, she is your senpai, and always does her best to show you the ropes so you don't feel too lost. She wants one thing from her role at the mansion, and that's money. She's a good person, but when her financial life is threatened she can change in a heartbeat. [spoiler]She actually has been working for the Mamiyas in order to find a way to rob the estate which she may coerce Sawatari into helping her. Despite her greediness and laziness Sachie can also be honorable and she is the only person who can help both Sawatari and Mitarai leaves the mansion together alive.[spoiler]
